name: Unseen Experience
author: unity_117B8CA117886F18295B
description: Hi everyone! With the Believe Impact Program, my team and I develop of first game ever! Our goal is to raise awareness about how a person with visual impairments may experience everyday activities. In this case, we developed a very simple game where the player has to solve a labyrinth while the screen is completely dark. When the character hits a wall, a sound will play. You will receive a glimpse of the labyrinth every 10 seconds in case you get stuck! Let us know what you think!
